prs.title: fix(auth): enforce form-urlencoded Content-Type for token endpoint
prs.author: lanxevo3
prs.reason: [llm pick] cluster primary for issue #1160: Both PRs have unknown CI status and unknown test coverage. Applying the next tiebreaker (smallest focused diff): #1774 changes 1 file vs #1713's 3 files. Additionally, #1774 directly enforces the spec-required application/x-www-form-urlencoded Content-Type at the token endpoint (a targeted bug fix), while #1713 adds a new onInputValidationError callback — a broader API surface change that works around the missing enforcement rather than fixing the root cause. A direct enforcement fix is the more appropriate approach for a missing Content-Type invariant.
